modeling_role: Defines what rows of the feature matrix represent
review_requirement: Document whether observations are people assets documents regions time periods sensors cases simulations or systems
responsible_use_warning: Rows may carry ethical institutional or domain-specific meaning that compression can obscure

modeling_role: Defines what columns measure or encode
review_requirement: Record units measurement sources proxies missingness transformations and feature provenance
responsible_use_warning: Features can encode noise bias proxy relationships or historical artifacts

modeling_role: Defines centering scaling imputation transformation filtering and outlier handling
review_requirement: Document all preprocessing parameters and ensure they are fit only on training data when used in predictive workflows
responsible_use_warning: Preprocessing choices can determine which features dominate the reduced representation

modeling_role: Defines how many dimensions are retained
review_requirement: Record explained variance reconstruction error stability evidence downstream validation and domain justification
responsible_use_warning: Variance thresholds alone can discard rare local minority or high-stakes structure

modeling_role: Measures what is lost by the low-dimensional approximation
review_requirement: Inspect total per-feature per-observation subgroup and task-specific reconstruction error
responsible_use_warning: Low average error can hide concentrated loss for important cases

modeling_role: Prevents validation data from influencing preprocessing or component fitting
review_requirement: Fit scaling and dimensionality reduction inside training folds or training data only
responsible_use_warning: Leakage can inflate model performance and make validation unreliable

modeling_role: Defines how component scores loadings clusters and visual patterns may be described
review_requirement: Review loadings domain evidence stability and whether labels are justified
responsible_use_warning: Components are mathematical mixtures not automatically causal factors or natural categories

modeling_role: Defines what the reduced representation can and cannot support
review_requirement: Attach preprocessing choices component count uncertainty notes validation status and stop-use conditions to outputs
responsible_use_warning: Dimensionality reduction should support accountable analysis not replace domain review
